title: SEC Form 4/4-A fail-closed timestamp and retry integrity hardening

findings.description: parse_utc silently assigned UTC to timezone-naive timestamps, contrary to Phase 477's explicit-timezone rule.
Rows collected before a failed watermark/pagination check were appended to canonical events.csv and then permanently deduplicated on later successful retries.
findings.disposition: suppress canonical event rows from every incomplete poll; retain page observations and retry against last successful watermark

changes: parse_utc returns None unless the parsed datetime has an explicit timezone offset.
fetch_feed emits canonical event rows only when poll_success is true.
incomplete poll candidate and suppressed-candidate counts are exposed in feed and poll summaries.
regression tests cover naive timestamps and incomplete-poll recovery on a later successful retry.

initial_attempt.reason: SyntaxError in test context-manager line continuation; fixed in follow-up commit
